# sigma_workbook_materialization_schedules (Data Source)

Lists materialization schedules for a Sigma workbook using the paginated v2.1 endpoint. Results preserve Sigma API order; key collections by returned IDs rather than positional indices. Pagination cursors and page sizes are not exposed; this data source retrieves every page.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "sigma_workbook_materialization_schedules" "example" {
  workbook_id = "workbook-id"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `workbook_id` (String) Workbook ID.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Stable identifier for this data source.
- `schedules` (Attributes List) Materialization schedules in API order. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--schedules))

<a id="nestedatt--schedules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `schedules`

Read-Only:

- `configured_at` (String) When the schedule was configured (`configuredAt`).
- `element_id` (String) Identifier of the element being materialized (`elementId`).
- `element_name` (String) Element name (`elementName`).
- `paused` (Boolean) Whether the schedule is paused (`paused`).
- `schedule` (Attributes) Cron schedule (`schedule`). Null when Sigma returns no schedule. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--schedules--schedule))
- `sheet_id` (String) Identifier of the materialization schedule for the element (`sheetId`).

<a id="nestedatt--schedules--schedule"></a>
### Nested Schema for `schedules.schedule`

Read-Only:

- `cron_spec` (String) Cron expression (`cronSpec`).
- `timezone` (String) Timezone code (`timezone`).
